english.title: Prevent other appearing before / answering question of an authorised person defined in s.110(3D) pursuant to s. 108(4)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse prevented **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) from

(A)_[appearing before **(..SPECIFY AUTHORISED PERSON..), an authorised person,]_
(B)_[answering a question to which an authorised person, namely **(..SPECIFY AUTHORISED PERSON..), may have required an answer]_

pursuant to section 108(4) of the Environment Act 1995 in respect of the operations of

(C)_[a water undertaker or sewerage undertaker,]_
(D)_[a water supply licensee or sewerage licensee within the meaning of the Water Industry Act 1991,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY UNDERTAKER OR LICENSEE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 110(2)(c), 110(3D) and 110(3E) of the Environment Act 1995.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Authorised person is a person under section 110(3D) of the Act for the terms of this offence. The authorised person must be acting in respect of operations of a water / sewerage undertaker or water supply / sewerage licensee.
(ii) Powers and duties includes powers or duties exercisable by virtue of a warrant under Schedule 18 to the Environment Act 1995.
(iii) See alternative offence, when the offence is committed by against any other authorised person: H14853.
(iv) See the Water Industry Act 1991 for the meaning of a water supply licensee or sewerage licensee.
(v) See section 110(5I) for offences committed by body corporate.

other.penalty:
Either-way
Summary: maximum 6 / 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictable: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 110(3E)(a) of this Act and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
